controlled_protocol.query_policy: Merge and globally deduplicate Task-B pairs from eval_dataset.json, sample with seed 2026, and fill short target tasks from eval_dataset_1.json and paired files already in data/tasks to obtain exactly 100 unique queries per task.
controlled_protocol.demo_policy: For each query, use a different input/output pair from the same Task B as the one-shot demonstration.
controlled_protocol.prompt_diffusion_text_policy: Use an empty content prompt with the released positive/negative quality prompts; infer the task only from the same-task visual demonstration.
controlled_protocol.note: There are 11 target tasks and 1,100 competitor queries; inpainting is excluded because it is not a Task B in the source graph. Model inference uses each official default. Metrics follow the existing T2T evaluation by resizing each prediction to its native target size.
